note: The input ELF section-header string table names the crafted SHT_GNU_HASH section .zgnu.hash so the fuzz harness selects the GNU decompression path.
The section name begins with .z, causing the harness to ask libelf to inflate GNU-style ZLIB section contents.
The GNU ZLIB header declares a 17-byte decompressed payload containing an opposite-endian partial GNU hash table.
After decompression the section keeps its SHT_GNU_HASH type, so the reset raw data is later converted as ELF_T_GNUHASH.
The destination conversion buffer is allocated but not initialized before the type-specific converter writes only complete GNU hash fields.
The opposite-endian ELF data path invokes elf_cvt_gnuhash to translate the decompressed section data into the malloc buffer.
With one trailing byte after the complete GNU hash words, the converter exits after the word loop without copying that leftover byte, leaving the corresponding byte in scn->data_base uninitialized.
The harness requests the converted section data after successful decompression, exposing the partially initialized converted buffer to MemorySanitizer.
